properties.name: Eloy – Picacho
properties.story: A long-known farm-pumping subsidence area. The sinking belt is real but modest in this record.
properties.land_use_note: Farmland all around (60 OpenStreetMap polygons within 3 km of the core); no mines nearby.
properties.source_note: Sentinel-1 OPERA DISP-S1, 2016 to 2026; outline is the study box, not the sinking area

properties.name: Willcox basin (ADWR: Kansas Settlement)
properties.story: The largest sinking area we found, in a valley with heavy irrigation pumping and the Willcox Playa crane habitat.
properties.land_use_note: Farmland all around (24 OpenStreetMap polygons within 3 km); no mines nearby.
properties.source_note: Sentinel-1 OPERA DISP-S1, 2016 to 2026; outline is the study box, not the sinking area

properties.name: Fort Grant Road, north of Willcox
properties.story: The fastest-sinking area we measured, north of the Willcox basin. ADWR maps it as the Fort Grant Rd subsidence feature.
properties.land_use_note: Not checked (map-service lookup failed). ADWR maps this as its Fort Grant Rd feature.
properties.source_note: Sentinel-1 OPERA DISP-S1, 2016 to 2026; outline is the study box, not the sinking area

properties.name: Elfrida area, south of Willcox
properties.story: A second sinking area in the same valley system, mapped by ADWR as the Elfrida subsidence feature.
properties.land_use_note: Farmland all around (19 OpenStreetMap polygons within 3 km); no mines nearby.
properties.source_note: Sentinel-1 OPERA DISP-S1, 2016 to 2026; outline is the study box, not the sinking area

properties.name: Bowie - San Simon, east of Willcox
properties.story: A large sinking area that ADWR maps as the Bowie-San Simon feature. We saw it from one satellite look direction only.
properties.land_use_note: Little farmland nearby (0 to 2 polygons); the cause is unclear.
properties.source_note: Sentinel-1 OPERA DISP-S1, 2016 to 2026; outline is the study box, not the sinking area
